title: Glob-aware pairwise lease-overlap algorithm

truth_table.reason: Windows case-fold: src/Foo.py and src/foo.py are one file.
Directory component SRC vs src folds together on Windows.
Every component differs only by case; folded tuples are identical.
Backslash is a separator on Windows; case-fold makes the paths equal.
Single-component case-only pair overlaps after casefold.
Alternating case across four components; folded equal.
Folded src/foo is a component prefix of src/foo/bar.py (dir containment).
Folded SRC equals src, which prefixes src/x.py.
Mixed-case path equals its folded form.
Extension and stem both case-only; Windows overlap.
src/*.py exact-matches src/main.py; equal tuples overlap.
* does not cross /; src/*.py cannot match src/sub/main.py and src/X.py is not a prefix unless X=sub, which fails *.py.
** consumes sub; *.py matches main.py.
main.txt does not match *.py; neither tuple prefixes the other.
** matches pkg; *.json matches data.json.
foo.* matches foo.py in the same directory.
? matches the single character c.
Same as p12: * stays in lib/; deep does not match *.so.
(src,) is a component prefix of (src, foo.py).
Directory lease covers files beneath it.
Overlap is symmetric: file under directory still intersects.
Trailing slash is stripped; src/pkg prefixes the nested file.
Part-wise prefix: (src,) is not a prefix of (src-sibling,). str.startswith would be wrong.
dir vs dirty is a sibling-shaped string prefix, not a path-part prefix.
b vs bb are distinct components.
foo and foo.py are siblings, not containment.
On posix the same case-only pair is two files; they do not overlap.
SRC is not a component-prefix of src/a.py when case is preserved.
src/** matches every descendant of src, including src itself.
** matches the empty path and every nonempty path, so it overlaps all leases.
** may match zero components, so src/**/x.py matches src/x.py.
Identical literals overlap (reflexive).
The same glob has a nonempty language; a match is a prefix of itself.
*.py and *.txt share no component string; neither match can prefix the other at this depth.
After src, a vs b are disjoint; ** cannot reach across a sibling component.
Root *.py is one component; src does not match *.py, so no prefix relation.
Windows treats \ as /; src/*.py matches src/foo.py.
Root token () is a prefix of every path tuple.
Symmetric of p38: a root lease overlaps src.
docs vs README.md are distinct first components; *.md never meets README.md at the root.
